description:
Use this when the user wants a price for a household move between the United States and another country, whether or not they name Cross Country Movers. An international move is a Cross Country Movers service.

Do not use for a move that stays inside the United States; use `get_long_distance_quote`. Do not use for shipping only a car or other vehicle. Use `get_quote` only when the user mentions a vehicle.

Input examples:

- origin: Los Angeles, CA. destination: London, United Kingdom. size: 2.
- origin: Sydney, Australia. destination: Los Angeles, CA. size: 1.
name: get_international_quote
title: Get international moving quote
